deferral_rationale: Reconciler binding severity-downgrade (code-review round 1, verdict PASS): the sweep regex is the critic-approved plan v3 item-3 regex verbatim, and the invariant's binding layer is intact — the runtime CLI guard's substring predicate (scripts/task.py:736) refuses EVERY digit-bearing reconcile-family kind at post time (exit 2, nothing appended), and the pre-existing --check-marker-registry lint (digit-inclusive MARKER_POST_* grammar, workflow_lint.py:1346) fails unregistered kinds in documented posting instructions in .claude/agents/*.md + SKILL.md. Executed probe: the anchor-free sweep regex still flags digit-AFTER-reconcil mutants via prefix truncation (epm:reconcile2-x yields offender epm:reconcile); only digit-between-prefix-and-reconcil shapes (epm:phase2-reconcile) evade, a shape absent from all 15 fleet-observed deviants. Residual = fail-loud doc drift recoverable in one corrected command, never a landed deviant row. The regex widening to the full marker grammar plus a digit-bearing mutant case is recorded as a standing recommendation in epm:review-reconcile v1.
